title: Presio media sidecar
description: Embedded-file attachment named media-slide-{N}-{id}.json inside a Presio PDF. A companion binary attachment media-{id}.{gif|mp4|webm} is also embedded when kind is 'file'; an HTML animation (kind 'html') embeds its page as media-{id}.html plus any asset files it lists.

kind.description: Media source type. Inferred as 'url' when `url` is present and `kind` is omitted, otherwise 'file'. 'html' is an HTML animation: a page (and its assets) run in a sandboxed frame on a clock Presio controls.

id.description: Stable identifier derived from the source path or URL (non-alphanumeric chars replaced with _).

mime.description: MIME type of the media. YouTube/Vimeo and HTML animations use text/html.

x_pt.description: Left edge of the overlay in PDF points, top-left origin.

y_pt.description: Top edge of the overlay in PDF points, top-left origin.

w_pt.description: Width of the overlay in PDF points.

h_pt.description: Height of the overlay in PDF points.

autoplay.description: Start playing automatically when the slide is shown.

filename.description: Name of the companion attachment: the media file (kind='file') or the animation's entry page (kind='html'). Required for both.

url.description: Source URL. Required when kind='url', 'youtube', or 'vimeo'.

video_id.description: Extracted video ID used for iframe embeds. Present when kind='youtube' or 'vimeo'.

assets.description: kind='html': the files the page loads, each embedded as its own attachment. `path` is the URL the page uses for it, relative to the entry page (e.g. 'js/app.js'); `filename` is the attachment.

sync.description: kind='html': whether viewers' copies follow the presenter's, or each viewer plays it themselves. The presenter can switch it during the talk.

controls.description: kind='html': show play/pause, restart and (when the length is known) a scrubber to viewers playing it themselves. The presenter always has them.

interactive.description: kind='html': pointer input (clicks, drags, hovers) reaches the page, for the presenter and for viewers playing it themselves.

poster_at.description: kind='html': the moment, in seconds, shown as its preview (thumbnails, the next-slide view, a downloaded PDF). Default: near the end, or 2s in when it has no set length.

duration.description: kind='html': the animation's length in seconds, for the scrubber and looping. Without it, it's measured from CSS animations when those are all it runs; otherwise it plays open-ended.
